title: A pro’s working day
description: Client booking with the length of the service, photos and wishes for the visit. The preparation and the rescheduling terms are gathered next to the time of the appointment.

blocks.text: A client sends a photo of the manicure she wants, but it is not delivered or arrives blurred. The pro asks her to send it to a personal number. The time of the appointment is already booked, while the preparation moves off into another thread.

quote.text: having a hard time getting my clients nail pictures clear on messages. Sometimes they don’t send and sometimes they are blurry. I then have to ask for them to send through my personal number so I can see clearly. Such a hassle.

blocks.text: Link the booking to the length of the service, the photos and the client’s wishes. Show which attachments are available to the pro, and keep them when the booking moves. A short note on the visit helps return to the agreement before the appointment.

Walk through one specialist’s bookings from the first request to the visit. Can she get a usable photo, clarify a wish and move the time without private messages? If the materials still have to be hunted down separately, the calendar is not yet bringing the preparation together.
